'''Stage III Beckons''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed in the [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier. Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|Uprooter}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a [[Stage II Beckon]] evolves.
*Spawned by [[Stage IV Beckon|Stage IV Beckons]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a Stage IV Beckon is killed.
*Spawns as a result of a Colony-buffed [[Reinforcement System#Colony Buff|Reinforcement System]]:
**Spawned randomly upon the death of Parasites larger than 1 block.
**Spawned randomly on [[Residue]].
**Spawned on [[Infested Blocks]], created by other Beckons.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage III Beckons are Stationary Block Infesters and Defensive Support parasites.

*Stage III Beckons are capable of spawning [[Rupter|Rupters]], [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]]<ref name=":0">Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Squid]].
#</ref>, [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive Mobs]]<ref>Excluding [[Primitive Devourer|Primitive Devourer.]]</ref>, [[Flying Carrier|Flying]] and [[Heavy Carrier|Heavy]] Carriers, and a major selection of [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pures]]<ref>Excluding [[Grunt]], [[Marauder]], and [[Monarch]].</ref> through the usage of [[Biomass]]. [[Stage III Beckon#Summoning and Mobs Value|More info below]]. 
*They're able to convert blocks, depending on their [[Hardness]]<ref>Max [[Hardness]] of the Blocks they can infest, by default, is 4.5. </ref>, to their Infested Variant. These include Infested Dirt, Stone and Wood. The Infestation can spread in a 16 block radius (8 blocks along the Y-axis) with a 50 second minimum Infestation cooldown per block radius.
**The same Infested Blocks can generate [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I Beckons]], extending the range of the Infested Zone. There can be a maximum of 2 Beckons per Chunk.
*Stage III Beckons are capable of spawning [[Sentry|Sentries]] and [[Kyphosis|Kyphosises]] on Infested Blocks, which act as a defensive line.
*Stage III Beckons throw 6 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. These bombs inflict 13 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage III Beckons can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 7, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 4 Blocks range.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Stage III Beckons will become [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II Beckons]].

=== ''Summoning'' ===
Stage III Beckons are capable of spawning various [[Mobs]], through the usage of Biomass.

The summoning Ability is based on Points. Each Mob has a certain Points value. Spawned Parasites will either be sorted by Ground type or Air, Parasites categorized as Air type will be spawned instead of Grounded if the target is 3 blocks above the summoner.

'''Stage III Beckons have a total of 12 Points per summon and can summon 2 mobs before its cooldown of 14 seconds with a cap of 12 parasites active at once.'''

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage III Beckons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Stage III Beckons will take damage over time and die if the current dimension is at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] or lower.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Like all Nexuses, Stage III Beckons do not despawn by default.
*Beckons are also known as '''VenkrolSIII''' in the Mod Files.
*Contrary to popular beliefs, Beckons aren't Plants, despite looking like one. Biomass isn't Eggs, either. Eggs aren't present in any part of Parasites Life Cycle.
*Beckons use Biomass to clone [[Mobs]].
*Stage III Beckons' Model present roots. They use the roots to extract an unknown type of Energy from underground, which they use to infest blocks, clone Mobs and evolve.
